meta.kit: M/darbnica - Jugendstil / Secession ornament kit (new retro direction)
meta.colour: every SVG uses currentColor; set CSS color on the parent (inline SVG or mask-image) - as an it renders black

weights.note: weights are in each ornament's own units; most are drawn to be used at roughly 1:1 to 2:1 px

meta.path_commands: M L C Z only (arcs converted to cubic beziers) so every path works in SVG, Path2D, Figma and clip-path

clip.note: drawn for a 2:3 portrait box; other ratios stretch the arch

outline.note: outer line inset by half its weight so it sits on the clip edge; hairline 9 units inside

whiplash-h.label: Whiplash, horizontal (curl left, tail runs out to the right)
whiplash-h.note: curvature-continuous curve (Euler-spiral curl); tail is dead level at the bottom-right so it can continue as a CSS rule

whiplash-v.label: Whiplash, vertical (curl top, tail runs down)

secession-border-tile.label: Secession border tile (Moser bars with circles + Hoffmann squares); seamless in x
secession-border-tile.css: background: url(secession-border-tile.svg) repeat-x left center / auto 100%;

secession-border-tile-v.label: Same tile rotated for vertical borders; seamless in y

stem-sunflower.label: Stylised sunflower on a long stem, whiplash leaves, root curls

corner-loop.label: Corner flourish: the frame rule ties a teardrop loop (top-left)

frame.note: rules leave the box at the right and bottom edges; continue them with 1.5 / 0.75 lines

corner-secession.label: Geometric corner: rules cross and overshoot, checker in the cut-off square (top-left)

halo-sunburst.label: Radiating halo: 24 bundles of 3 fine rays, jewel dots, inner ring

logo.note: logo diameter = half the halo box; inner ring r=112
